sandbachFocus: League leaders Sandbach United host Alsager Town on Saturday at 15:00. Sandbach sit top with 22 points from 10 games and arrive on the back of a recent loss, but their underlying record remains strong with seven wins from their last six games before that defeat. Alsager, bottom of the table with just 4 points from 10 matches, will present little resistance as they struggle badly this season.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town travel to Dawley Town in a fixture between mid-table sides, with Stafford holding a two-point advantage over the chasing pack. Third-placed AFC Bridgnorth host Eccleshall in a clash of in-form teams—both showing recent upswings after earlier stumbles. Wolverhampton Casuals, also on 19 points, welcome Wednesfield Community at home on Saturday before a midweek trip to face Brereton Social on Wednesday. Bilston Town (5th) welcome Foley Meir in a battle of sides with contrasting trajectories. New Mills host Market Drayton Town in a fixture between mid-table strugglers, while Barnton face Shawbury United—the latter winless in their last six. Cheadle Heath Nomads visit Telford Town in a bottom-half affair, and Crewe host Allscott Heath in another encounter between lower-league sides. Brereton Social begin the week at home to Widnes Town on Saturday before their Wednesday evening trip to Wolverhampton Casuals.
